markers.name: Lumen City
markers.description: The neon heart of the Bloom network. A sprawling vertical metropolis of light, speed and constant surveillance.

markers.name: Crown Spire
markers.description: Seat of Crown Division command. A fortified high-rise district bristling with relay towers and enforcement nodes.

markers.name: Black Harbor
markers.description: Primary coastal hub for the Bloom courier network. Cargo flows day and night under neon dock lights.

markers.name: Blackwake Harbor
markers.description: An aging port district. Smugglers, freelancers and abandoned relay barges line the waterfront.

markers.name: Tidal Relay Array
markers.description: Off-shore relay node boosting Bloom signals along the western coast.

markers.name: Horizon Station
markers.description: Central transit junction. Couriers from all factions pass through on contested ground.

markers.name: Relay Woods
markers.description: A quiet relay outpost hidden in dense forest canopy near Crown territory.

markers.name: North Relay Station
markers.description: The northernmost signal relay. Barely maintained, often offline.

markers.name: South Line Terminal
markers.description: End-of-line transit terminal serving the southern marshlands.

markers.name: Bay Market
markers.description: Open-air bazaar district beneath Lumen City. Everything has a price.

markers.name: Bloomrot Village
markers.description: A settlement overtaken by wild bloom growth. Beautiful and dangerous.

markers.name: South Marshes
markers.description: Waterlogged lowlands at the map's southern edge. Sparse population, thick fog.

markers.name: Split Gate
markers.description: A circular fortification at a major crossroads. Control shifts between factions constantly.

markers.name: Forest Gate Alpha
markers.description: Crown Division forward operating base guarding the eastern forest perimeter.

markers.name: The Fray Ranch
markers.description: Stronghold of the Fray Coalition. A fortified ranch compound in hostile territory.

markers.name: Pirate Relay
markers.description: Rogue relay station operated by pirate couriers on the eastern frontier.

markers.name: Ironhold Industrial Zone
markers.description: Heavy manufacturing district. Rusted infrastructure, high security, low questions asked.

markers.name: Bloom Shelter Basin
markers.description: Underground bloom processing facility concealed beneath farmland.

markers.name: Crown Checkpoint
markers.description: Crown Division security checkpoint. All traffic scanned and logged.

markers.name: Old Canal Yard
markers.description: Abandoned canal lock converted into a neutral-zone checkpoint.

markers.name: Grayline Fields
markers.description: Abandoned canal lock converted into a neutral-zone checkpoint.
